fingerprintDefinitions.debugStrippedExecutablePrototypeSha256: Hash of recursive params,vararg,stack,instruction words,constant values and upvalue bindings. Debug source/line/local names excluded. Matching records are not proof of equal complete runtime behavior under different globals,task geometry,assets or platform APIs.
fingerprintDefinitions.numericWildcardFingerprint: Same prototype record, but every numeric constant replaced with a single placeholder. Used to identify candidates for manual layout review only; numeric constants can change loop bounds/ranges/function behavior.
fingerprintDefinitions.opcodeSequenceFingerprint: Hash of recursive opcode-number sequences; operands and constants are ignored. A shape aid only, never semantic equivalence.
